trainer/31978.htm.text: Prefect Tazeer: What do you think is the strongest weapon of the Orcs? No, not the axe or warhammer! It is our own bodies! But youngsters these days don't even know how to make the most of this amazing weapon. Do not neglect your own training.

trainer/31978-noteach.htm.text: Prefect Tazeer: Are you OK? Have you taken leave of your senses? You don't even know who your teacher is! Snap out of it, and go find a teacher!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/31978-01.html.text: Prefect Tazeer: ll glory flows from the great fire! Are you a young soldier of the Orc Kingdom? Surely you realize that you must prove your loyalty in order to be an Orc Raider. The test is very simple. Unlike in your land, there are many lower Orcs here, who hold much power... Any move against the…

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/31978-03.html.text: Prefect Tazeer: The traitorous Timora Orcs can be found near the lake between the Crypts of Disgrace and the Den of Evil ! Now go and bring me back one of their heads!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/31978-05.html.text: Prefect Tazeer: Tejakar Oroca! Tejakar Renegade Raider! You've brought me the head of a traitor! Please accept this Mark of the Raider! Take it to the High Prefect and he will qualify you as an Orc Raider if your skills are good enough! Glory be with you, young Orc!
when: state STARTED; memo 3; has items 8544; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/31978-02.html.text: Prefect Tazeer: Excellent! I won't tell you that you won't be in serious danger, but I believe that you're skilled enough to defeat the Timora Orcs. Bring me one of their heads and I'll reward you with the Mark of the Raider! Go now!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/31978-04.html.text: Prefect Tazeer: Very well! Then pay close attention! The Timora Orcs betrayed us by joining the dreaded Ragna Orcs, who have long been the scourge of this area. links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
